headline: Quitting and closing, the family way
highlights: ⌘Q asks before losing work, and only then. A session with unsaved matches, approvals, or edits gets one plain question — Save and Quit, Quit Anyway, or Cancel — and a job still running (matching, transcription, an export) gets Quit Anyway or Cancel. A clean, idle session quits silently.

⌘W closes the window and only the window — no prompt. The app keeps running, the session stays exactly as it was, and a click on the Dock icon brings the window back with everything in place. Closing the window no longer quits the app, and choosing Don't Save on close can no longer throw a session away.
